output.answer_markdown: The passages describe Amcor's fiscal 2022 Other Restructuring Plans as triggered by the Russia-Ukraine conflict, to help mitigate the impact of disposed earnings from the Russian sale [1]. Charges in fiscal 2023 covered employee related, fixed asset, other restructuring and restructuring related expenses [2]. The passages mention an analysis of the restructuring plan liability, excluding restructuring related liabilities, but give no balance [3]. The material does not state the restructuring liability as of Q2 of FY2023.
